row.notes: Renamed from Career_RndHeads_Link_EntryToGroupAndFlag: RndHeads came only from the caller name; the body looks the id up in the EntrantRecord list from (self+0x270)->vtbl+0x1c8 (id at +0x50/+0x52). Data flow: if both ids are valid (hi != 0x3fff), finds the group in the hash map at self+0x2b0 (key group lo << 14 | hi) and scans its id vector (value+0x18..+0x20); already present gives flag 1, otherwise logs errno 2, appends *entrant_id and flag stays 0. Then, if the entrant record has bit 0x10 in +0x4b, stores the flag per entrant in the map at self+0x2f8 (existing value+8, or a new 0x10 object with vtbl UNK_1456bff30 inserted by FUN_1410e7d30 at self+0x2e8). Context from caller: all three pass (record+0x50, record+0x58), i.e. the record's own id and its group/team id; Career_Load_RndHeads calls it during load, 0x14106dbf0 after moving a record between groups, 0x1410702b0 at the end of a set-group operation.
